comment: The shader programs of the graphics layer. Each program is its sources concatenated in order, translated by tools/shaders/generate.py. outputs lists what is generated; hand_written names a platform's own version, by its header, which the generator leaves alone. pairs are the vertex and fragment entries the compile checks pair into pipelines. fast_math, false by default, lets the Metal backend compile the program with fast math; only a program whose output no float rounding can change sets it.
